title: Genesis 38:27-30 — twins Perez and Zerah and the scarlet thread
summary: Genesis 38:27-30 in English: Tamar gives birth to twins, the midwife ties a scarlet thread on the hand of the one who comes out first, and the twins are named Perez and Zerah. Tamar and 'scarlet thread' / 'scarlet' are highlighted, over a faint red thread drawn across the background.

text.text: 27 It came about at the time she [Tamar] was giving birth, that behold, there were twins in her womb.
28 Moreover, it took place while she was giving birth, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This one came out first.”
29 But it came about as he drew back his hand, that behold his brother came out. Then she said, “What a breach you have made for yourself!” So, he was named Perez.
30 Afterward his brother came out who had the scarlet thread on his hand; and he was named Zerah.

pictures.description: A faint, translucent pink-red twisted thread or cord winding in a wavy S-shape across the whole slide behind the text, rising at the right edge.
